title: Public Git History Personal-Identifier Remediation Maintainer Decision Recording v0.1
objective: Record the maintainer's explicit choice among accept_risk, authorize_rewrite_planning, replace_repository_planning, or defer, preserve redacted evidence and authority boundaries, and select a bounded follow-up without executing any Git-history or external-state change.
acceptance: Record exactly one explicit maintainer choice: accept_risk, authorize_rewrite_planning, replace_repository_planning, or defer.
Keep every identifier value redacted in the decision record and evidence.
Record the decision rationale, accepted risk, and authority boundary without treating planning authorization as execution authorization.
Select a bounded follow-up Goal consistent with the explicit choice.
Do not rewrite Git history, force push, replace the repository, rotate credentials, contact anyone, publish, launch, deploy, or change repository settings.
